prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, and whether you need creative/brand work, performance/digital, PR, B2B, ecommerce, etc.

To help you quickly, two nationally recognized agencies with big operations in KC are:
- Barkley — known for strong creative/branding work and national consumer campaigns.
- VML/VMLY&R — a large integrated agency with digital, tech and brand capabilities.

If you want a tailored recommendation, tell me:
- What services do you need (branding, social, SEO, PPC, email, PR, web/app, growth marketing, etc.)?
- Your industry (B2B, retail, healthcare, SaaS, nonprofit, etc.)
- Monthly or annual budget range
- Preferred agency size (local boutique vs large global agency)
- Timeline (ongoing vs one-off project)

How I can help next
- I can shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies matched to your answers (with strengths, typical fees, and recent example work).
- Or I can give an RFP template and interview questions you can use to vet agencies.

Quick checklist and interview questions to use when evaluating agencies
- Ask for relevant case studies and measurable results (KPIs, ROI, CPA, LTV improvements).
- Who will be on our account team and how often will we meet?
- What tools/tech do you use for reporting and campaign management?
- How do you structure pricing (retainer, project, performance)?
- Can you share references from clients in our industry or of our size?
- What does success look like for the first 3, 6, 12 months?

Tell me your needs and budget and I’ll build a short, specific list of Kansas City agencies that match.
